articles.title: Gold Drops $100 in Sharpest Daily Fall as Oil Spike Fuels Rate-Hike Fears
articles.excerpt: Precious metals sell off despite geopolitical turmoil as surging oil prices stoke inflation worries, but Citi and UBS see gold doubling in the long run.
articles.image_caption: Gold crystals in their natural form. Gold futures fell 2.4% on Thursday to $4,046.50 per ounce as surging oil prices reignited inflation and rate-hike fears.
articles.nri_angle: India is the world’s second-largest gold consumer, and the price decline directly impacts wedding-season gold purchases and NRI investment portfolios.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mortgage Rates Hit 2026 High as Treasury Yields Flash Warning for Homebuyers
articles.excerpt: The 30-year fixed rate jumped to 6.85%, with economists warning 7% is back on the table as the Iran war drives oil past $100 and Treasury yields to 18-month highs.
articles.nri_angle: NRI homebuyers and investors face rising borrowing costs that reduce purchasing power and delay refinancing plans for U.S. properties.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Infosys Q1 Profit Jumps 12% but Trimmed Growth Outlook Signals Caution
articles.excerpt: India's second-largest IT firm posted strong earnings and surging AI revenue, but narrowed its FY27 guidance amid an uneven macro environment and named a new CEO to steer the company through an industry-wide AI transition.
articles.image_caption: Infosys headquarters campus in Bangalore, India. The company reported Q1 FY27 results on July 23, 2026, with a 12.2% jump in net profit.
articles.nri_angle: Infosys is a major employer of Indian tech workers globally; its guidance affects H-1B hiring and Indian IT sector
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: QatarEnergy Extends LNG Force Majeure as Hormuz Closure Deepens Global Energy Crisis
articles.excerpt: The world's largest LNG exporter has extended supply suspensions to India and South Korea through at least mid-September, leasing out tankers into October as renewed Iranian attacks keep the Strait of Hormuz shut.
articles.image_caption: The Strait of Hormuz, the critical waterway through which roughly one-fifth of the world's oil passes. QatarEnergy has declared force majeure on LNG deliveries as the strait remains closed.
articles.nri_angle: India is world's 4th largest LNG importer; higher LNG prices directly impact Indian energy costs and inflation
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Jobless Claims Plunge to 187,000, Lowest Level Since 1969
articles.excerpt: First-time unemployment filings fell by 22,000 last week, far below economists' expectations, as the American labor market continues to defy a broader economic slowdown.
articles.image_caption: The Frances Perkins Building, headquarters of the U.S. Department of Labor in Washington, D.C. Weekly initial jobless claims fell to 187,000, the lowest level since November 1969.
articles.nri_angle: Strong US labor market directly benefits Indian immigrants and H-1B workers in the US job market
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Pulls In $20 Billion From Diaspora, but Oil Surge Keeps Rupee Pinned Near Record Low
articles.excerpt: India's push to attract dollar deposits from overseas Indians has drawn over $20 billion in a month, yet the rupee continues to weaken as surging oil prices and an internal RBI debate on intervention strategy compound currency pressures.
articles.image_caption: Indian rupee banknotes displayed at a currency exchange counter. The rupee traded near 96.50 per dollar on July 23, hovering close to its all-time low of 96.96 hit in May.
articles.nri_angle: The RBI's foreign-currency deposit scheme directly targets the 37-million-strong Indian diaspora, offering NRIs 6-7% returns with no currency risk — a rare chance to earn high domestic rates while parking dollars in Indian banks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: ECB Holds Rates Steady but Signals September Hike as Middle East Conflict Drives Energy Prices Higher
articles.excerpt: The European Central Bank kept its deposit rate at 2.25% on Thursday, but President Christine Lagarde signaled the door remains open to further tightening as oil prices climb above $100 a barrel.
articles.image_caption: ECB President Christine Lagarde at the central bank's headquarters. The ECB held rates steady on Thursday but left room for another hike as energy prices surge.
articles.image_credit: European Central Bank via Wikimedia Commons
articles.nri_angle: The ECB's hawkish stance and rising European bond yields could affect investment portfolios and currency exchange rates for the Indian diaspora with financial exposure to European markets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: American Airlines Slashes 2026 Outlook as Iran Conflict Sends Fuel Costs Soaring
articles.excerpt: The carrier beat Q2 earnings estimates on record $16.74 billion revenue, but a collapsing US-Iran ceasefire and surging jet fuel prices forced a sharp downward revision to full-year guidance, sending shares down over 4%.
articles.image_caption: An American Airlines Boeing 777-300ER in flight. The carrier reported record Q2 revenue but slashed its full-year outlook amid soaring fuel costs driven by the US-Iran conflict.
articles.nri_angle: Rising fuel costs are driving up airfares on US-India routes, affecting the large diaspora corridor between the two countries.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Comcast Beats Q2 Estimates as Peacock Turns First Profit Ahead of NBCUniversal Spinoff
articles.excerpt: The cable giant's streaming service posted $189 million in pre-tax income while the company beat earnings and revenue estimates, bolstering the case for its planned media business separation.
articles.image_caption: Comcast's corporate headquarters in Philadelphia. The company reported stronger-than-expected Q2 2026 earnings as Peacock streaming service turned its first profit.
articles.nri_angle: Relevant for diaspora investors tracking U.S. media and telecom stocks, with implications for global streaming competition and broadband market dynamics.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: IndiGo Swings to Rs 382 Crore Q1 Loss as Fuel Costs Surge 86%
articles.excerpt: India's largest airline reported a sharp reversal from Rs 2,161 crore profit a year ago, with crude oil above $100 per barrel driven by the Iran conflict pushing expenses 35% higher even as revenue grew 20%.
articles.image_caption: An IndiGo-branded Airbus aircraft on the tarmac at a delivery facility near Toulouse, France. The airline posted its second consecutive quarterly loss as fuel costs surged 86% in the April-June quarter.
articles.nri_angle: IndiGo's financial struggles and leadership transition affect flight options and pricing for the Indian diaspora traveling between India and global destinations.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Big Tech Earnings Deliver Mixed Signals for Micron's AI Memory Boom
articles.excerpt: Alphabet's record $44 billion in AI capital spending signals sustained memory chip demand, but Tesla's earnings miss and Google's custom chip ambitions add uncertainty for the $1 trillion chipmaker.
articles.image_caption: Micron Technology's office in San Jose, California. The memory chipmaker's $1 trillion market capitalization is being tested by mixed Big Tech earnings signals and concerns about AI memory demand sustainability.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American investors with significant semiconductor exposure are watching whether Big Tech's AI spending sustains Micron's rally or if custom chip innovations cap returns.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex, Nifty Extend Losses for Fourth Day as Crude Oil Nears $100
articles.excerpt: Brent crude surged past $98 a barrel on escalating US-Iran tensions and Houthi attacks on Red Sea tankers, dragging Indian benchmarks to their longest losing streak in seven weeks.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai. The BSE Sensex fell 363 points on July 23, extending losses for a fourth consecutive session amid surging crude oil prices.
articles.nri_angle: Rising crude oil prices and a weaker rupee could increase costs for NRI remittances and impact Indian-origin investors with exposure to Indian equities and mutual funds.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Law Firms Probe HDFC Bank Over Alleged Maharashtra Deposit Payments
articles.excerpt: Three separate US securities firms are investigating whether India's largest private lender misled investors about ₹45 crore in payments disguised as marketing expenses.
articles.image_caption: HDFC Bank's corporate signage at a branch location. Three US law firms are investigating the lender over allegations it disguised payments to a Maharashtra state agency as marketing expenses.
articles.nri_angle: HDFC Bank is one of the most widely held Indian stocks among NRI investors through its NYSE-listed ADRs, and any formal class action could directly affect US-based shareholders.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wall Street Braces for Fed Rate Hold, but Rate Hike Talk Grows Louder
articles.excerpt: All 104 economists in a Reuters poll expect the Federal Reserve to hold rates at its July 28-29 meeting, but a growing majority now sees the probability of a rate increase this year as high.
articles.image_caption: The Marriner S. Eccles Federal Reserve Board Building in Washington, D.C. The Fed's policy committee meets July 28-29 to decide on interest rates amid rising debate over whether a rate hike may be needed this year.
articles.nri_angle: Higher-for-longer US rates keep mortgage costs elevated for Indian-American homebuyers while widening the dollar-rupee carry trade, making remittances more valuable but dollar education loans more expensive.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Vishal Mega Mart Shares Tumble After Q1 Results Despite 26% Profit Jump
articles.excerpt: India's largest value retail chain reported ₹258.8 crore in net profit and ₹3,727 crore in revenue for the June 2026 quarter, but decelerating growth and leadership changes weighed on investor sentiment.
articles.image_caption: Coverage of Vishal Mega Mart's Q1 FY27 earnings announcement. The value retailer posted 25.6% profit growth but its stock fell sharply on growth deceleration concerns.
articles.nri_angle: Indian diaspora investors tracking VMM since its December 2024 IPO face a familiar tension between strong retail fundamentals and elevated valuations as growth normalizes.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Rolls Out First Export-Grade Shipping Container, Challenging China's 95% Grip
articles.excerpt: DCM Shriram Group delivered the first EXIM-certified container to Maersk at Dadri, Uttar Pradesh, backed by a ₹10,000 crore government scheme to build domestic manufacturing capacity tenfold.
articles.image_caption: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal unveils India's first EXIM-grade shipping container at Maersk-CONCOR's Dadri depot. The container, built by DCM Shriram Group, marks India's entry into a market dominated almost entirely by Chinese manufacturers.
articles.nri_angle: Reduced container costs and supply chain resilience would benefit Indian exporters and lower trade disruption risk for diaspora businesses engaged in India-linked commerce.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Iran's Ghalibaf Warns 'If We Don't Sell Oil, No One Will' as Strait Crisis Deepens
articles.excerpt: Iran's top negotiator signals Tehran could expand disruptions to all Gulf oil exports as the Strait of Hormuz remains blocked and Houthi proxies target Saudi shipping routes.
articles.image_caption: Mohammad Baqer Ghalibaf, Iran's top negotiator and former parliament speaker. Ghalibaf warned that unless Iran can export oil, no Gulf state will be allowed to either.
articles.nri_angle: India's 27 percent drop in Middle East oil imports directly impacts fuel prices and the refining sector, with potential knock-on effects for the Indian economy and cost of living both domestically and abroad.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Powerball Jackpot Climbs Past $567 Million After No Winner in Wednesday Drawing
articles.excerpt: The winning numbers were drawn but no ticket matched all six, pushing the prize higher for Saturday's drawing. Non-U.S. citizens are eligible to play.
articles.image_caption: The Powerball jackpot has climbed past 67 million after no winner was drawn on Wednesday. The next drawing is scheduled for Saturday, July 26.
articles.nri_angle: Non-U.S. citizens and residents can legally purchase Powerball tickets, though non-resident winners face a higher 30% federal tax withholding rate compared to the standard 24%.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals Stock Surges 19% After Triglyceride Drug Aces Two Phase 3 Trials
articles.excerpt: Plozasiran delivered up to 81% triglyceride reduction and eliminated acute pancreatitis risk in patients with a history of the condition, putting Arrowhead on track for a broader FDA filing by year-end.
articles.image_caption: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals' stock surged 19% after its experimental triglyceride-lowering drug met key endpoints in two Phase 3 clinical trials.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American biotech investors and healthcare professionals tracking the triglyceride treatment market will find ARWR's Phase 3 results and upcoming FDA filing timeline significant for portfolio positioning.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: IBM Cuts Revenue Forecast as AI Spending Shift Hammers Mainframe Business
articles.excerpt: The tech giant lowered its 2026 growth outlook to 4%-5% after mainframe sales plunged 42% and enterprise clients redirected budgets toward AI infrastructure, confirming a profit warning that triggered the worst stock drop in IBM's history.
articles.image_caption: IBM's corporate headquarters in Armonk, New York. The 115-year-old technology company cut its full-year revenue growth forecast on July 22, 2026, after enterprise clients shifted spending toward AI infrastructure.
articles.nri_angle: IBM's pivot toward AI execution carries direct implications for its large Indian-origin workforce across operations in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Pune, as well as tens of thousands of Indian-origin professionals in the US, with consulting and software — the segments IBM counts on for growth — employing a significant share of India-based and diaspora talent.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Oil Hits Six-Week High as Brent Tops $95 on Twin Strait Supply Fears
articles.excerpt: Brent crude settled up 3.36% at $94.07 after briefly touching $95.47, as the US-Iran conflict escalated and Houthis announced a naval blockade of Saudi Arabia.
articles.image_caption: The Strait of Hormuz, one of the world's most critical oil chokepoints. Brent crude has topped $95 a barrel amid fears of supply disruptions through the strait.
articles.nri_angle: India, the world's third-largest oil importer, faces widening current account pressure as Brent nears $95, with every $10 increase adding roughly 0.4% of GDP to the deficit and weakening the rupee.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gold Surges to Two-Week High Above $4,100 as Iran Strikes Revive Safe-Haven Bid
articles.excerpt: Comex gold settled up 1.86% at $4,146.90 as the US-Iran conflict escalated into its 11th night of airstrikes, with analysts eyeing $4,375 as the near-term target.
articles.image_caption: Gold bars. Gold prices surged to a two-week high above $4,100 an ounce as Iranian missile strikes on Israel revived safe-haven demand.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors face dual exposure through dollar gold prices and rupee depreciation driven by rising oil import costs, while the RBI's reserve accumulation provides structural support.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dr Reddy's Q1 Profit Drops 69% on Semaglutide Supply Halt, Revlimid Exit
articles.excerpt: The Hyderabad drugmaker booked a Rs 240 crore provision after an API impurity forced it to suspend generic Wegovy production, while the loss of Revlimid revenues and a 35% North America revenue slump compounded the earnings hit.
articles.image_caption: G V Prasad, Co-Chairman and Managing Director of Dr Reddy's Laboratories, at the company's Q1 FY27 results announcement. Dr Reddy's reported a 69% drop in net profit to Rs 443 crore, hit by semaglutide production issues and the loss of Lenalidomide revenues.
articles.nri_angle: Dr Reddy's is listed on the NYSE (ticker RDY) and derives significant revenue from North America. New US tariffs on generic medicines and the company's semaglutide supply disruption directly affect drug availability and pricing for the Indian diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wall Street Treads Water as Alphabet, Tesla Earnings Loom and Oil Tops $92
articles.excerpt: Nasdaq futures slip while Dow holds steady ahead of the first Magnificent Seven earnings prints of the season, with surging oil prices and Middle East tensions adding to the uncertainty.
articles.image_caption: The New York Stock Exchange on Wall Street. Markets treaded water ahead of major earnings from Alphabet and Tesla.
articles.nri_angle: Impact on Indian-American tech workers at Google/Tesla and NRI investors exposed to both U.S. equities and Indian markets affected by oil price spike
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tesla Reports Q2 Earnings Today as Wall Street Watches Margins and Musk's AI Pivot
articles.excerpt: With record deliveries of 480,000 vehicles but expected margin compression, investors are focused on whether Tesla's AI spending on robotaxis and robots can justify a $25 billion capital plan.
articles.image_caption: Elon Musk, Tesla CEO. Tesla reports Q2 2026 earnings as Wall Street watches margins and the company's pivot toward AI and robotaxis.
articles.nri_angle: Tesla is among the most widely held US stocks by Indian retail investors; margin and AI spending trends are key for diaspora investors with TSLA exposure.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Oil Surge Drags Nasdaq Lower While Super Micro Rallies on Margin Surprise
articles.excerpt: Rising crude prices and U.S.-Iran tensions weighed on Wall Street Wednesday, but AI server maker Super Micro Computer surged nearly 20% after doubling its gross margin forecast and reporting a record $60 billion backlog.
articles.image_caption: A stock market data display showing financial figures and trading activity. Wall Street indexes closed mostly lower on Wednesday as rising oil prices from the U.S.-Iran conflict offset gains from AI server stocks.
articles.nri_angle: Rising oil prices pressure India's import-heavy economy and pharma tariffs threaten Indian generics, creating dual headwinds for diaspora investors with exposure to both U.S. and Indian markets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Eternal's Profit Misses Estimates Even as Blinkit Hits Margin Milestone
articles.excerpt: Zomato's parent posted a 268% year-on-year profit jump to ₹92 crore, but a 47% sequential decline and a miss on analyst forecasts overshadowed Blinkit's improving unit economics.
articles.image_caption: Blinkit, the quick-commerce arm of Eternal (formerly Zomato). The unit hit a margin milestone even as the parent company's profit missed estimates.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: BPCL Posts First Quarterly Loss in 15 Quarters as Crude Prices Crush Fuel Margins
articles.excerpt: India's second-largest state-owned fuel retailer reported a net loss of ₹3,962 crore for Q1 FY27 as elevated crude oil prices from Middle East tensions pushed marketing margins deep into negative territory.
articles.image_caption: A Bharat Petroleum (BPCL) facility. The state-run oil company posted its first quarterly loss in 15 quarters.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with Indian oil sector holdings face volatility as state-run fuel retailers absorb losses from high crude prices and frozen retail fuel prices.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US 30-Year Treasury Yield Nears Longest Stretch Above 5% Since 2007
articles.excerpt: The benchmark long bond has stayed above 5% for 11 straight sessions, driven by renewed Middle East tensions, persistent inflation, and a wave of corporate debt issuance from AI hyperscalers.
articles.image_caption: The U.S. Treasury building in Washington, D.C. The 30-year Treasury yield is nearing its longest stretch above 5% since 2007.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with US fixed-income or real estate exposure face higher mortgage costs and shifting bond dynamics as Treasury yields persist above 5%.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: BlueStone Stock Surges 20% After Third Straight Profitable Quarter
articles.excerpt: The omnichannel jewellery retailer posted ₹6 crore net profit in Q1 FY27 on 49% revenue growth, hitting the upper circuit as investor confidence strengthens.
articles.image_caption: A BlueStone Jewellery retail store. The company reported its third consecutive profitable quarter in Q1 FY27, sending shares to the upper circuit.
articles.nri_angle: BlueStone's growth trajectory and stock performance offer Indian diaspora investors a lens into the organised jewellery retail opportunity in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Russia's Fuel Crisis Deepens as Drone Strikes Slash Refinery Output by 40%
articles.excerpt: Moscow diverts Siberian fuel and imports gasoline from India as Ukrainian attacks leave production at 65% of seasonal demand, with Crimea under rationing and farmers squeezed by soaring diesel costs.
articles.image_caption: An oil refinery. Drone strikes have slashed Russian refinery output by 40%, deepening the country's fuel crisis.
articles.nri_angle: India has become Russia's second-largest fossil fuel buyer with record crude imports of 2.64 million bpd in June, while Russia has begun importing refined gasoline from India, reshaping the bilateral energy relationship and affecting India's fuel pricing and sanctions exposure.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: TVS Motor Signals Potential Spin-Off of TVS Credit Financial Services Arm
articles.excerpt: Chairman Sudarshan Venu told shareholders the company will evaluate alternatives for its financial services subsidiary TVS Credit, which now has a ₹30,000-crore asset base and 24.4 million customers.
articles.image_caption: TVS Motor Company, the Indian multinational exploring a spin-off of its credit arm
articles.nri_angle: TVS Motor is a widely held stock among NRI investors, and a potential TVS Credit spin-off could create a separate investable financial services entity of interest to the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Trump Announces Phased Tariffs of Up to 200% on Generic Drug Imports
articles.excerpt: The new tariff plan gives generic drugmakers a two-year duty-free window before imposing 100% tariffs from August 2028 and 200% from 2029, rattling Indian pharma stocks.
articles.image_caption: US President Donald Trump. Trump has announced phased tariffs of up to 200% on generic drug imports, targeting India's pharmaceutical industry.
articles.nri_angle: Higher generic drug prices in the U.S. could directly impact millions of Indian Americans who rely on affordable prescriptions, while Indian pharma companies with U.S. operations may be positioned to benefit.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US to Cut Aluminium Tariffs in Bid to Strengthen Defence Supply Chain
articles.excerpt: The tariff reduction aims to secure domestic aluminium supply for military needs, with ripple effects for Indian aluminium producers and global trade flows.
articles.image_caption: An aluminium production facility. The US plans to cut tariffs on aluminium imports to bolster its defence supply chain.
articles.nri_angle: India is a major aluminium producer with companies like Hindalco and Vedanta exporting to global markets. The tariff changes could affect Indian metals exports and investment flows.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bira 91 Founder Ankur Jain Exits After Two-Year Standoff, Surrenders 17.8% Stake to Investors
articles.excerpt: The craft beer pioneer signed a settlement with lenders and institutional shareholders, ending a bitter dispute marked by unpaid salaries, employee protests, and halted production.
articles.image_caption: Ankur Jain, founder and former CEO of B9 Beverages, at a Bira 91 company event. Jain has resigned from the board and surrendered his family's entire 17.8% stake as part of a settlement with investors.
articles.nri_angle: Bira 91, once a symbol of India's craft beer revolution and popular among urban NRIs, faces an uncertain future as its founder exits and the company seeks fresh capital to resume operations.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Middle East Oil Imports Plunge 27% as Hormuz Crisis Forces Shift to Russia
articles.excerpt: Russian crude now accounts for 41% of India's oil imports after Strait of Hormuz disruptions cut Middle East supplies, with refiners also turning to Brazil, Venezuela and Angola.
articles.image_caption: A supertanker at sea loaded with crude oil. India's reliance on Russian and Latin American crude surged in the April-June quarter as Strait of Hormuz disruptions cut Middle East supplies by 27%.
articles.nri_angle: India's surging oil import bill and supply chain disruption threaten higher fuel prices and inflation that directly affect household budgets and remittance purchasing power for the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nifty 50 Tests 24,100 Support as Banking Rout and Middle East Tensions Weigh on Markets
articles.excerpt: Indian benchmarks face a third straight session of pressure as HDFC Bank's margin weakness, rising crude oil prices near $90 a barrel, and escalating Middle East conflict keep sellers in control.
articles.image_caption: The National Stock Exchange of India building in Mumbai. Indian equity benchmarks have declined for two consecutive sessions amid banking sector weakness and geopolitical uncertainty.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with Indian equity holdings face near-term portfolio pressure from banking sector margin concerns and elevated crude oil prices driven by Middle East tensions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: iD Fresh Food to Double UAE Capacity With New Sharjah Factory as It Targets $1 Billion IPO
articles.excerpt: Founder P.C. Musthafa says the Bengaluru-based fresh food company will open its second Gulf production facility by December and list on an Indian exchange by October 2027.
articles.image_caption: iD Fresh Food produces idli and dosa batter, parathas and chapatis at its factory in Ajman, UAE. The company plans to open a second production facility in Sharjah by December 2026 to meet growing Gulf demand.
articles.nri_angle: iD Fresh's expansion in the UAE and planned entry into Singapore, the UK and the US directly serves the Indian diaspora's demand for fresh, preservative-free Indian staples abroad.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Infosys Q1 Results: All Eyes on FY27 Guidance as IT Giant Reports Thursday
articles.excerpt: Analysts expect double-digit revenue growth driven by acquisitions, but remain divided on whether Infosys will trim its full-year outlook amid global demand uncertainty.
articles.image_caption: Infosys campus in Bangalore, the headquarters of India's second-largest IT services company. The firm reports its June quarter earnings on July 23, with investors closely watching its full-year guidance.
articles.nri_angle: Infosys employs tens of thousands of Indian-origin tech professionals globally, and its guidance shapes hiring and H-1B visa trends across the US tech corridor.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Yen Slides Past 163 to Four-Decade Low as Tokyo Signals Readiness to Intervene
articles.excerpt: The Japanese currency hit 163.24 per dollar — its weakest since 1986 — as surging oil prices and rising U.S. Treasury yields bolstered the greenback, prompting Japan's finance minister to warn that decisive action could come 'at any time.'
articles.image_caption: The Bank of Japan headquarters in Chuo, Tokyo. The central bank's cautious approach to rate hikes has kept the yen under persistent selling pressure.
articles.nri_angle: A weaker yen benefits Indian travellers and students in Japan, but forced Japanese selling of U.S. Treasuries to fund intervention could tighten global financial conditions and weigh on Indian equities.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Trump Announces 100% Tariff on Generic Drug Imports Starting August 2028
articles.excerpt: President Trump said generic pharmaceuticals will remain tariff-free for two years before facing rates of 100% and eventually 200%, in a push to reshore manufacturing to the U.S.
articles.image_caption: President Donald Trump announced sweeping tariffs on imported pharmaceuticals
articles.nri_angle: Indian pharma companies that supply nearly half of U.S. prescriptions face a two-year countdown before tariffs of up to 200% could reshape the industry that employs millions across India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Super Micro Shares Surge After Preliminary Results Show Record Backlog and Doubled Margins
articles.excerpt: The AI server maker posted more than $60 billion in new orders during its fiscal fourth quarter and expects gross margins nearly double its earlier forecast, sending shares up 17% after hours.
articles.image_caption: Super Micro Computer shares surged after the company reported record backlog and improved margins
articles.nri_angle: Super Micro's record AI server backlog signals continued growth in Silicon Valley's data-centre ecosystem, where Indian-origin professionals are heavily represented. The company's Chief Business Officer Vik Malyala is of Indian origin, and the broader AI infrastructure boom creates opportunities for Indian IT services firms.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Goldman Sachs Launches Private Markets Platform to Give Wealthy Clients Direct Access to Pre-IPO Companies
articles.excerpt: The Wall Street bank is consolidating its alternatives businesses under a new platform led by Matt Doherty, as demand from wealthy investors for stakes in private companies surges amid the AI boom and SpaceX's blockbuster listing.
articles.image_caption: Goldman Sachs headquarters at 200 West Street in Lower Manhattan, New York. The bank announced a new private markets platform to expand alternative investment access for wealthy clients.
articles.nri_angle: The platform gives NRI and Indian-origin investors with significant US-based assets another route into high-growth pre-IPO companies through Goldman's expanding alternatives offering.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Northrop Grumman Beats Earnings Estimates but Stock Slides on Margin Concerns
articles.excerpt: The defense giant posted Q2 EPS of $7.68, well above the $6.82 consensus, and raised its full-year outlook, but operating income declines in two key segments sent shares to a new 52-week low.
articles.image_caption: A Northrop Grumman B-21 Raider stealth bomber in flight. The B-21 program drove a 13% revenue increase in Northrop's aeronautics segment during the second quarter.
articles.nri_angle: U.S.-based Indian investors holding defense stocks face continued sector headwinds despite Northrop's record backlog, with midterm election risks adding uncertainty to the defense budget outlook.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wall Street Landlords Dump 3,000 Homes in Q2 as Federal Buying Ban Takes Effect
articles.excerpt: Eight major institutional landlords became net sellers of over 3,000 single-family homes this spring, a fivefold jump from a year ago, as the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act reshapes corporate homeownership in America.
articles.image_caption: A row of single-family homes in a suburban American neighborhood. Institutional landlords have accelerated sales of homes like these after the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act took effect.
articles.nri_angle: Indian Americans in competitive Sun Belt markets may face slightly less competition from corporate buyers, though the broader inventory shortage remains the primary barrier to homeownership.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: InMobi Taps JPMorgan and Jefferies for $1 Billion India IPO
articles.excerpt: India's first unicorn has appointed four investment banks to manage its upcoming public offering, seeking a valuation of up to $6 billion as it re-domiciles from Singapore.
articles.image_caption: InMobi CEO Naveen Tewari, who holds about 40% of the company. The Harvard-educated founder is steering India's first unicorn toward a landmark domestic IPO.
articles.nri_angle: InMobi's listing offers diaspora investors a rare chance to access India's first unicorn through public markets, amid a broader wave of tech IPOs reshaping the country's digital economy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Russian Oil Imports Hold Near Record Highs Despite Expired US Sanctions Waiver
articles.excerpt: Indian refiners imported 2.45 million barrels per day of Russian crude in July, just below June's record 2.64 million bpd, as the Hormuz crisis reshapes global energy flows.
articles.image_caption: YouTube / India Today
articles.nri_angle: India's surging oil import bill and growing dependence on Russian crude amid the Hormuz crisis directly affect the rupee's stability and the cost of living for families back home.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The Great Rotation: Why Wall Street's Chip Stocks Are Crashing While Banks and Energy Surge

articles.nri_angle: Indian investors abroad face portfolio decisions as oil prices threaten margins and inflation narrows the RBI rate-cut window.

articles.title: India-UK Free Trade Pact Takes Effect, Targeting $100 Billion in Bilateral Trade by 2030
articles.excerpt: The landmark agreement eliminates duties on 99% of Indian exports to Britain and exempts 75,000 Indian professionals from double social security contributions.
articles.image_caption: India and the United Kingdom signed the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement in July 2025. The pact took effect on July 15, 2026, covering goods, services, and professional mobility.
articles.nri_angle: The Double Contribution Convention exempts 75,000 Indian workers in the UK from paying into Britain's National Insurance system, directly benefiting the Indian diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Three Indian Founder-Led Companies Investors Are Watching: Nykaa, Infosys, and Marico
articles.excerpt: Founder-driven companies with strong growth profiles and premium valuations are drawing attention from retail investors seeking quality Indian market exposure.
articles.image_caption: Traders at the Bombay Stock Exchange in Mumbai. Indian founder-led companies are attracting retail investor attention amid strong earnings growth and premium valuations.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors tracking Indian markets can access these stocks through BSE and NSE, with Infosys also listed on NYSE as ADRs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Foreign Investors Return to Indian Equities After Four-Month, $29 Billion Selloff
articles.excerpt: FPIs have invested over ₹15,000 crore in Indian stocks in July, ending a brutal selling streak. Jefferies' Chris Wood and Goldman Sachs say India's valuations are finally looking attractive again.
articles.image_caption: A stock market trading screen displaying price movements. Foreign portfolio investors have returned as net buyers of Indian equities in July 2026 after four months of sustained selling totaling over ₹2.61 lakh crore.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors watching Indian markets from abroad now face a potential entry point, with valuations correcting below five-year averages and both domestic and foreign institutional flows turning positive.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Flags 'Double Standards' as US Senate Bill Threatens 100% Tariffs on Russian Oil Buyers
articles.excerpt: New Delhi warns the bipartisan legislation — which exempts European gas importers while targeting India, China, and three other nations — could damage bilateral ties and ongoing trade negotiations.
articles.image_caption: An oil refinery complex with industrial towers and piping. India's purchases of discounted Russian crude have surged since 2022, reaching record levels in June 2026.
articles.nri_angle: The proposed tariffs could affect all Indian exports to the US, directly impacting trade flows, Indian IT services, and NRI business interests in both countries.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wipro Falls as Brokerages Cut Targets and India’s $315 Billion IT Sector Faces AI-Driven Spending Squeeze
articles.excerpt: Jefferies, Citi, and BofA downgrade Wipro after weak Q1 results and guidance, as the broader Indian IT sector grapples with subdued client spending and AI-driven efficiency measures.
articles.image_caption: A trader monitors stock price movements on a digital display. Indian IT stocks have faced significant selling pressure as brokerages downgrade the sector’s growth outlook.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT companies employ hundreds of thousands of H-1B visa holders in the US, and their financial performance directly impacts NRI employees and diaspora investors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mortgage Rates Hit 6.55%, Highest Since Iran War Began, as Housing Market Stalls
articles.excerpt: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate climbed to levels not seen in 11 months as the US-Iran conflict drives oil prices and Treasury yields higher, crushing spring homebuying momentum.
articles.image_caption: A couple reviews mortgage paperwork at a home showing. Mortgage rates climbed to 6.55% this week, their highest level in 11 months, as the US-Iran conflict keeps bond yields elevated.
articles.nri_angle: NRI homebuyers in the US face a difficult rate environment as the Iran conflict keeps mortgage costs elevated, though rates remain below 2025 peaks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jio Financial Services Q1 Profit Surges 156% to Rs 830 Crore as Lending Engine Hits Rs 30,000 Crore
articles.excerpt: Mukesh Ambani's financial arm crosses the Rs 2,000 crore revenue mark for the first time, with assets under management nearly tripling year-on-year to Rs 30,667 crore.
articles.image_caption: A stock market trading screen displaying financial data. Jio Financial Services shares rose over 3 percent following the company's Q1 results, which showed profit more than doubling year-on-year.
articles.nri_angle: Jio Financial's aggressive scaling across lending, payments, and asset management signals a new era of competition in India's financial sector, relevant to NRI investors tracking Reliance's fintech ambitions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wipro Stock Drops as Brokerages Slash Targets After Weak Q1 Results and Guidance
articles.excerpt: Jefferies, Citi, and BofA cut price targets and retain bearish ratings after Wipro's revenue miss and soft Q2 outlook, while Nomura remains a contrarian bull on deal momentum.
articles.image_caption: A stock market display board shows trading data and price movements. Wipro shares fell 2.3% on July 17 after the company reported weak Q1 results and softer-than-expected guidance for the September quarter.
articles.nri_angle: Wipro is dual-listed on the NYSE (WIT) and NSE, making its stock accessible to NRI investors; the company has returned over $3 billion to shareholders in the past year via buybacks and dividends.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HDFC Bank Q1 Profit Rises 5% to ₹19,060 Crore as Provisions Plunge
articles.excerpt: India's largest private lender posted steady earnings growth in the June quarter, broadly meeting analyst estimates, as a sharp drop in bad-loan provisions offset a decline in treasury income.
articles.image_caption: Stock market trading screens displaying financial data. HDFC Bank reported a 5% rise in June quarter profit to ₹19,060 crore, driven by lower provisions and accelerating loan growth.
articles.nri_angle: HDFC Bank, India's largest private lender and a widely held stock among NRI investors, posted steady quarterly growth amid leadership transition.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Rallies 965 Points as IT, Banking Stocks Defy Global Selloff
articles.excerpt: Indian benchmarks closed sharply higher on Friday, with the Sensex jumping 1.25% and the Nifty crossing 24,334, powered by IT and financial heavyweights even as Asian and US markets tumbled.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai, home to Asia's oldest stock exchange. On Friday, the Sensex surged 965 points as IT and banking stocks powered Indian markets higher despite a global selloff.
articles.nri_angle: The RBI's special overseas deposit scheme could attract $30 billion from NRIs, while the rupee's weekly decline and elevated US bond yields create a complex remittance and investment landscape for the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Top Banks Post Strong Q1 Results as ICICI Leads With 16 Percent Profit Jump
articles.excerpt: ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, PNB, Axis Bank and Kotak Mahindra all reported profit growth in the April-June quarter, signalling broad-based strength across the banking sector.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai. India's top banks reported strong Q1 FY27 earnings on Saturday with ICICI Bank leading private lenders with a 16 percent profit increase.
articles.nri_angle: Indian bank stocks are widely held by NRI investors; strong results support portfolio positions in ICICI, HDFC and Kotak Mahindra.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Retail Inflation Breaches RBI Target for First Time in 17 Months as Food and Fuel Costs Surge
articles.excerpt: Consumer prices rose 4.38% in June, driven by higher vegetable prices and fuel cost pass-through from the Iran conflict, clouding the outlook for interest rates.
articles.image_caption: Indian rupee coins arranged together. Consumer price inflation in India rose to 4.38% in June 2026, breaching the Reserve Bank of India's 4% target.
articles.nri_angle: Rising inflation may delay rate cuts and affect NRI investment returns, rupee-denominated remittances, and real estate decisions in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: TCS Posts Strong Q1 as AI Revenue Hits $2.6 Billion Run Rate, Plans 8,900 AI Engineers and Acquisition Push
articles.excerpt: India's largest IT exporter beat revenue estimates on banking demand and accelerating AI deployments, though order book dipped and AI revenue growth slowed from the prior quarter.
articles.image_caption: A team of professionals collaborating in a modern office setting. Tata Consultancy Services reported a 14 percent revenue increase in Q1 FY27 and plans to deploy up to 8,900 AI engineers.
articles.nri_angle: TCS is the largest employer of H-1B visa holders and a bellwether for Indian IT professionals working in the US; its AI pivot signals the sector's direction.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: JSW Steel Profit Doubles to ₹4,696 Crore in Q1 as Record Sales and Margin Expansion Lift India's Largest Private Steelmaker
articles.excerpt: Higher steel prices, a 46 percent surge in exports and aggressive debt reduction powered a strong quarter for the JSW Group flagship.
articles.image_caption: A JSW Steel manufacturing facility. The company reported its strongest first-quarter performance in several years, with profit more than doubling to ₹4,696 crore.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors tracking Indian equities see JSW Steel's results as evidence of India's infrastructure-driven earnings cycle.

articles.title: SEBI, NSE Sound Alarm on 'Boss Scam' and Fake Trading App Frauds
articles.excerpt: India's markets regulator has issued a fresh warning about cybercriminals impersonating CEOs to trick employees into transferring funds, while the NSE flags AI-generated deepfake videos of its chief recommending stocks.
articles.image_caption: A stock market trading screen displays financial data. Indian regulators SEBI and NSE have issued fresh warnings about cyber fraud schemes targeting investors and corporate employees.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors managing portfolios remotely through digital platforms are prime targets for fake trading apps and WhatsApp-based advisory scams that exploit distance and time-zone gaps.

articles.title: India-UK Trade Deal Takes Effect as First Zero-Duty Shipments Leave Indian Ports
articles.excerpt: Exports worth $140 million shipped on Day One under the new CETA agreement, which eliminates tariffs on 99% of Indian goods entering Britain and opens 137 services sub-sectors.
articles.image_caption: Shipping containers at a commercial port. India shipped $140 million in duty-free exports to the UK on the first day of the new trade agreement.
articles.nri_angle: The social security exemption under the Double Contribution Convention directly benefits over 75,000 Indian professionals working in the UK, reducing employer costs and potentially increasing hiring of Indian talent.

articles.title: RBI Bans Lenders From Selling Seized Assets Back to Defaulting Borrowers
articles.excerpt: New prudential norms under the Resolution of Stressed Assets Directions, 2025 prohibit banks, small finance banks, and NBFCs from selling acquired non-financial assets back to defaulters or their related parties, effective October 2026.
articles.image_caption: The Bank of India building in Mumbai. The RBI's new norms target how lenders handle immovable assets seized during loan recovery.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs with Indian property investments gain transparency as the RBI mandates public auctions for seized assets and bans sell-backs to defaulters, while investors get cleaner bank balance sheet disclosures.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gold Drops Below $4,000 as Iran Conflict Fuels Fed Rate Hike Fears
articles.excerpt: The precious metal posts its worst weekly loss in six weeks as rising oil prices from U.S.-Iran hostilities revive inflation concerns and push rate-hike odds to 73% before December.
articles.image_caption: Gold bullion bars stacked for storage. The precious metal fell below $4,000 an ounce this week, its lowest level in eight months.
articles.nri_angle: Indian gold demand has frozen as price volatility widens dealer discounts to $19/oz, while RBI continues building gold reserves at $105 billion — a dynamic that matters for diaspora households planning wedding-season purchases.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: JPMorgan Engages Over 100 Multinationals as GIFT City Emerges as Global Treasury Hub
articles.excerpt: More than 100 companies have approached JPMorgan to set up corporate treasury operations at India's GIFT City, as the financial hub's banking assets cross $100 billion.
articles.image_caption: An aerial view of GIFT City in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India's first international financial services centre. The hub's banking assets have crossed $100 billion as it attracts global banks and multinational treasury operations.
articles.nri_angle: GIFT City's growth as a global treasury hub is creating demand for finance and treasury professionals with cross-border expertise, potentially drawing diaspora talent back to India.
